selected_primary_idea.title: ScaleBridge: A Pressure-Safe Critical-Envelope Program
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Potential first singularities of smooth 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes flows
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A non-circular, scale-invariant local depletion estimate can force a decay of the velocity-pressure concentration envelope at every candidate singular scale.
falsification_conditions: A normalized countersequence violates the proposed one-step decay under all stated hypotheses.
The pressure or far-field strain cannot be controlled in the declared envelope.
The rescaled limit lies outside the rigidity theorem class or the required nontriviality step fails.

rejected_ideas.title: Physical ultraviolet cutoff proof
rejected_ideas.reason: It changes the continuum PDE problem.

rejected_ideas.title: Promote public solution declarations without audit

mcts_evolution_summary.finding: Energy estimates and critical continuation criteria leave G1 open.
Localization is necessary but pressure and far-field strain create G4.
A typed critical-envelope route gives a theorem endpoint and an obstruction endpoint.

claim_audit_policy: Recent solution declarations remain CLAIM_UNDER_AUDIT unless every formal obligation is independently discharged.
